recipes.name: Chicken Adobo
recipes.instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Marinade
In a large bowl, combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and black pepper. Mix well to coat the chicken evenly.

Step 2: Marinate the Chicken
Cover the bowl and let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes. For best results, marinate overnight in the refrigerator.

Step 3: Brown the Chicken
Heat cooking oil in a large pan over medium heat. Remove chicken from marinade (reserve the marinade) and brown the chicken pieces on all sides for 3-4 minutes per side.

Step 4: Cook the Adobo
Pour the reserved marinade over the browned chicken. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.

Step 5: Season and Serve
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Remove bay leaves before serving. Serve hot with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Pork Adobo
recipes.instructions:
Step 1: Prepare the Meat
Cut the pork belly into serving-size pieces. In a large pot, combine pork, soy sauce, vinegar, minced garlic, bay leaves, and black pepper.

Step 2: Marinate
Let the pork marinate in the mixture for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Step 3: Cook the Adobo
Place the pot over medium heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 45-60 minutes until pork is tender and sauce has reduced.

Step 4: Add Water
If the sauce becomes too dry, add 1/2 cup of water and continue simmering.

Step 5: Serve
Remove bay leaves before serving. Serve hot with steamed rice.
